achievements.name: My Favourite Painting
achievements.description: I definitely need more pictures on my wall. Especially...

achievements.name: Birthday
achievements.description: At least my birthday will be a bit sooner.

achievements.name: Wah Wah Wah Waaah
achievements.description: I wish I could play my favourite tune on my instrument to ease the pain of solitude.

achievements.name: The Halls of Eternity
achievements.description: l read about the halls of eternity, a place where time stands still.

achievements.name: The Map
achievements.description: I could really use a map of the kingdom.

achievements.name: The End of Longing
achievements.description: When will my longing end?

achievements.name: Secret Tower
achievements.description: The cave is supposedly full of hidden places.

achievements.name: The Library
achievements.description: There is a secret library somewhere in the kingdom. I could use some more books, so I'd very much like to find it.

achievements.name: A Face
achievements.description: I'd really like to converse with someone. Anyone...

achievements.name: Running Water
achievements.description: I could use some running water in my home. Not that I have any need for hygiene, I just like the sound.

achievements.name: Head of a Horse
achievements.description: It is very lonely down here. From time to time it would be nice to see another pair of eyes.

achievements.name: Colorful Stones
achievements.description: I wish I had more colors for my art studies. It should be possible to find some different colored stones in the cave.

achievements.name: Becoming Darkness
achievements.description: Where is this darkness?

achievements.name: Dream
achievements.description: I wish I could dream of another place.

achievements.name: Bed
achievements.description: A bed would be a nice addition to my furniture. I could probably build one if I had the right materials.

achievements.name: Mattock
achievements.description: A mattock would be a nice tool to have down here.

achievements.name: Leaving Darkness
achievements.description: Will I ever overcome it?

achievements.name: Disappointing Achievement
achievements.description: I should make a list of my failings. Maybe that will be a small accomplishment at least.

achievements.name: Crystal Glory
achievements.description: There are crystals in many colors. I could harvest some of them and decorate my room.

achievements.name: Home Improvement
achievements.description: I could try to enlarge my little home by hacking through the walls.

achievements.name: Avid Reader
achievements.description: I really need to read more...

achievements.name: Neverending Notebook
achievements.description: My dream would be to find a book that never ends.

achievements.name: Home Sweet Home
achievements.description: My home is not comfortable enough for this long wait.

achievements.name: Mushroom Gardener
achievements.description: Luckily I don't need to eat, but it would be nice to grow some pretty mushrooms.

achievements.name: The Cave
achievements.description: I wonder when I will have discovered every part of the cave?
